title: scenario order_to_cash: seeds end-state amount_paid/balance on all 95 invoices, so a build with amount_paid as a roll-up and an open-balance cap refuses 66 of 72 payments
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cysZsTQwxLv9M2TzHH

Out-of-scope finding (class a) from area a4-A's #34986 pass (os-dev report 7022810829). The scenario card's seed data writes end-state `amount_paid` and balance on every invoice, so any build that models `amount_paid` as a roll-up of payments with an open-balance cap refuses exactly 66 of 72 payment rows. The fix is the scenario card data / runner, not the skills.
Done when: the card's seed carries opening state (or the runner seeds in an order the roll-up can follow) and a build of that shape loads every payment row.
Dedupe read: order_to_cash, amount_paid, end-state — only #34986.
